<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Jay Nolan on 11/11/2024 10:32 AM
---------------------------

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.

From: Inter-Dept Football Challenge @ Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd 21/10/2000 10:38 PM

Sent by: Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd Announcements@kestrelaero.co.uk
To: Inter-Dept Football Invite
cc:
Subject: Kestrel Inter-Departmental Charity Football Tournament Invitation


Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Bristol Airframes are proud to sponsor the 2nd Annual Kestrel-Bristol Airframes Flag Football Challenge on Saturday, November 16. The purpose of this event is to raise money for both companies' chosen charities, and to enjoy the competitive spirit of the third oldest rivalry in corporate football. This year's game marks the 107th meeting between Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd Manufacturing and Bristol Airframes Supplier Quality, and, with a little luck, the Aerospace Industry League Title will be on the line!

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Bristol Airframes are sponsoring the event, but we need your help as participants and fundraisers. Contributions raised will benefit the general charity fund for each company.

The details:
Date: Saturday, November 16th

Time: 10:00 a.m. - approximately 4 p.m. (Warm up is at 9:30 am)

Location: Aerospace Park (just off Junction 19, south of the M4)

Food and Drinks: Pasty Palace (FREE - courtesy of Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd)

Eligibility: Full-time employees and/or their spouses
(Players must have graduated from Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd or Bristol Airframes)

Team Jerseys: Provided by Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Bristol Airframes

Format: 7 players with at least 1 female player on the field at all times

Team Size: Recommend 8-10 players per team (no more than 10 per team) Contact the team captains to sign-up. (Sign-up now to ensure your place on a team)

Prizes: Winning team receives 16 tickets to the Kestrel/Bristol Airframes game in Bristol on Friday, November 22 Winning team also owns "Golden Rivet" trophy until next year!

Fundraising Goal The committee has set a goal of raising £16,000 for each charity. This will require a contribution of £2,000 per team, plus an equal amount from corporate matching funds.

Last year's event featured a last-minute comeback as Kestrel Contracts Team 1 defeated the Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd Manufacturing Team 1 for the championship and took home the tickets and the trophy. This year, expect the Manufacturing team (and Bristol Airframes) to come in with revenge on their minds!

Thanks to the gracious gift from the Bristol Airframes Alumni, who redirected their donations to the Kestrel Foundation, we were able to permanently endow scholarships dedicated to the memory of the 12 engineers who died in last year's hangar collapse. We believe this event is a great tradition for both companies, and we are pleased to be able to raise important funds for both institutions.
</quoted>
